statements.t: As we move closer to the government’s traceability deadline, we expect these events to further reinforce the need for reliable, end-to-end traceability.
ReposiTrak is uniquely positioned as the only provider offering true, touchless traceability from farm to shelf, and we expect demand to accelerate as the deadline approaches.”
